1.title: Left wheel dropped
1.detail: Left wheel is not contacting the floor.
1.action: Place Alfred on a hard floor and clear debris under the wheel.

2.title: Right wheel dropped
2.detail: Right wheel is not contacting the floor.
2.action: Place Alfred on a hard floor and clear debris under the wheel.

5.title: Left wheel jammed
5.action: Remove hair/debris from the left wheel well.

6.title: Right wheel jammed
6.action: Remove hair/debris from the right wheel well.

7.title: Left brush jammed
7.action: Clear the side brush and housing.

8.title: Right brush / main brush jammed
8.action: Remove and clean the extractors / main brush.

9.title: Dust bin missing
9.action: Re-seat the dust bin until it clicks.

10.title: Bumper stuck
10.detail: Front bumper is pressed or jammed.
10.action: Tap the bumper free and check for obstacles.

11.title: Left cliff sensor dirty
11.action: Wipe cliff sensors with a dry cloth.

12.title: Right cliff sensor dirty
12.action: Wipe cliff sensors with a dry cloth.

14.title: Wheel dropped / navigation failed
14.action: Move Alfred to open floor space and restart clean.

15.title: Navigation problem
15.detail: Alfred cannot build or follow a path.
15.action: Clear clutter; ensure good lighting; retry.

16.title: Battery issue
16.action: Reseat on Home Base; check contacts.

17.title: Cliff sensors failed
17.action: Clean sensors; if persistent, service unit.

18.title: Bin full
18.action: Empty the bin and re-seat it.

21.title: Docking problem
21.detail: Could not dock on Home Base.
21.action: Clear path to Home Base; wipe charging contacts.

22.title: Software update required
22.action: Complete any pending local update via app once, then return to LAN MQTT.

24.title: Localization failed
24.action: Carry Alfred to Home Base and start a new mission.

25.title: Vacuum stalled
25.action: Clear bin, filter, and vacuum path.

26.title: Battery overheating
26.action: Let Alfred cool on a hard floor; do not charge until cool.

1.title: Near full / near empty battery
1.action: Charge Alfred before starting a clean.

2.title: Bin full
2.detail: Cannot start while bin is full.

5.title: Busy
5.detail: Already running a mission or docking.
5.action: Wait or pause/stop the current cycle.

6.title: Handle lifted / carrying
6.action: Set down gently and wait a few seconds.

7.title: Charging / docked constraint
7.detail: Current dock/charge state blocks this command.
7.action: Undock with Clean or wait until charged.

15.title: Charging — settling on the dock
15.detail: Seen briefly right after Alfred docks: it is charging and not yet ready to accept a new command. It clears on its own within a few seconds.
15.action: No action needed — wait a moment and retry.

16.title: Just docked / busy
16.detail: Robot is on the dock and finishing up; not ready for a new command yet.
16.action: Give it a few seconds, then retry.

31.title: Docked and charging
31.detail: Command not available while charging on the dock.
31.action: Start a clean to undock, or wait until charged.
